The Process

From Missed Call to Booked Appointment

In under 60 seconds, your shop goes from losing a customer to having them on the schedule.

📵
Step 1
Call Missed
A customer calls — no one answers. They're about to call your competitor.
⚡
Step 2
Instant Auto-Text
Within seconds, the system texts the customer: "We missed your call — we'll call you right back!"
📊
Step 3
Spreadsheet Alert
The customer's name and phone number appear instantly on a live spreadsheet on the advisor's computer.
📞
Step 4
Advisor Calls Back
The advisor sees the alert and calls immediately — before the customer dials anyone else.
💰
Step 5
Sale Recovered
The customer books the appointment. A $350 sale that was about to be lost is now on the schedule.
